messages.body: Attaching files to a ticket stopped working for us yesterday. Steps to reproduce: 1) open any ticket, 2) click 'Add attachment', 3) select an 8 MB PDF, 4) click Upload. The upload bar reaches 100% and then shows '413 Request Entity Too Large'. Your docs at help.example.com say the limit is 25 MB, so an 8 MB file should be fine. Chrome 126 on Windows 11, same result in Edge.
